controls: 点击画面或按空格放钩，听发音寻找目标。
controls_en: Click or press Space to drop the hook; listen for the target.

controls: 点击或按空格放钩，P 键暂停。
controls_en: Click or press Space to drop the hook; press P to pause.

controls: 用上下方向键或屏幕按钮选择食物。
controls_en: Use arrow keys or on-screen buttons to choose food.

controls: 拖动食物到分类篮；也可先点食物再点篮子。
controls_en: Drag food to a basket, or tap the food then its basket.

controls: 选择挑战模式，按提示点击或拖动。
controls_en: Choose a mode, then click or drag as instructed.

controls: 按订单点击或拖动食物，可选择接力模式。
controls_en: Click or drag food to fill orders; a relay mode is available.

controls: 2–3 人同屏，选择角色后轮流掷骰、答题。
controls_en: 2–3 players share a screen; choose characters, roll and answer in turn.

controls: 听发音，点击对应食物。
controls_en: Listen and click the matching food.

controls: 点击转盘字母拼出目标单词。
controls_en: Click letters on the wheel to spell the word.

controls: 先回答单词题，再点击地图放置防御塔。
controls_en: Answer a word question, then click the map to place a tower.

controls: 点击答案，通过单词关卡。
controls_en: Click an answer to complete each word challenge.

controls: 点击场景线索，按提示解谜。
controls_en: Click scene clues and solve the puzzles.

controls: 双人同屏，轮流掷骰并完成单词任务。
controls_en: Two players share a screen; roll and complete word tasks in turn.

controls: 四组轮流选择词卡，按课堂规则竞赛。
controls_en: Four teams take turns choosing word cards.

controls: 依次点击字母，拼出目标单词。
controls_en: Click letters in order to spell the target word.

controls: 跟随地图选择关卡并答题。
controls_en: Follow the map, select a level and answer questions.

controls: 红蓝两队同屏，点击配对词卡。
controls_en: Red and blue teams share a screen and click matching cards.

controls: 两队同屏，点击答案进行单词竞赛。
controls_en: Two teams share a screen and click answers to compete.

controls: 点击翻牌，将食物单词与图片配对。
controls_en: Flip cards to match food words with pictures.

controls: 点击翻牌，配对情绪单词与表情。
controls_en: Flip cards to match feelings with expressions.

controls: 双人同屏，先猜拳决定顺序，再轮流完成任务。
controls_en: Two players choose the first turn with rock-paper-scissors, then take turns.

controls: 点击词卡配对；联网 PK 需要双方网络连接。
controls_en: Click matching cards; online PK requires a connection for both players.

controls: 按住鼠标或手指滑动，切中目标单词。
controls_en: Hold and drag the mouse or swipe to slice the target word.

controls: 按住鼠标或手指滑动切词，可选择对战。
controls_en: Drag or swipe to slice words; a versus mode is available.

controls: 双人同屏，听题后点击对应地鼠。
controls_en: Two players share a screen; listen and click the matching mole.

controls: 点击翻格，右键插旗；触屏可切换插旗模式或长按。
controls_en: Click to reveal, right-click to flag; on touch, use flag mode or long-press.

controls: 听目标发音，点击画面放钩寻宝。
controls_en: Listen for the target and click to drop the hook.
